description.content:
Get the latest prices and other information for a list of symbols or symbol patterns.


**Note: The Dev Portal 'Try' feature does not currently work for the Market Data API.  To try the API, please see this site: https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/OAS/index.html or use the attached Postman collection.  Contact DTN here: https://www.dtn.com/contact-us/ for a trial account.**

query.description: (Required) A comma separated list of security symbols, security aliases, or search patterns.   Information about search patterns can be found here: [https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/SearchPatterns.aspx](https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/SearchPatterns.aspx) Keyword based symbol search can be done with the /market_data/symbol-search endpoint.  Or symbols can be searched for manually here: [https://ws1.dtn.com/PX/Search/](https://ws1.dtn.com/PX/Search/)
The number of symbols to return in one request up to a maximum of 4000.

Fields groups are collections of fields that are commonly used together.
If this parameter is not set, it will default to 'complete' which returns all available fields.  Setting the fields parameter
will override the default fieldGroups.  Specifying both fields and fieldGroups will return the union of the fields and field groups.

 

There are currently four field groups defined.  They are price, grains, racks, and complete.  The complete field group will return all available fields.  
Price will return fields that are useful for just getting the latest price for a symbol.  Grains is for grain elevator pricing.  Racks is field common 
to refined fuel energy racks.  More fields may be added to these groups in the future.  The fields in each group is listed below.  For more information 
on fields see the fields of a quote object.
      
- Price
  - last, high, low, open, bid, ask, close, previous, cumVolume, openInterest, change, week52High, week52Low, bidDateTime, askDateTime, tradeDateTime,
    description, month, settleDate, settlementPrice, expirationDate, contractHigh, contractLow, quoteDelay, commodity
- Grains
  - last, high, low, open, previous, change, tradeDateTime, underlying, description, basis, elevatorName, elevatorState, elevatorCounty,
    elevatorCity, elevatorZip, elevatorLatitude, elevatorLongitude, elevatorDistance, basisSymbol, fipsCode
- Racks
  - last, high, low, open, previous, change, tradeDateTime, description, effectiveDate, effectiveTime, rackCity, rackState, productName,
    productSupplier, summaryName, branded, grossNetIndicator, region

This parameter can be used to override the default fields returned from quote requests.  Pass a comma separated list of  field names to select what values are returned.  If fields and field groups are specified, the returned fields will be the union of the two.  If only fields are specified, then only those fields will be returned.  The field names are  the same as the properties of a quote object.

A page token returned from a previous request.  It is used to resume a request that 
  matched more symbols than the SymbolLimit allowed in one request.  More information on how to 
  make requests for many symbols can be found here: [https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/ManySymbols.aspx](https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/ManySymbols.aspx)

A market identifier to apply to all symbols and patterns in the request.  A list of markets can be found here: [https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/Markets.aspx](https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/Markets.aspx)

Get the latest prices and price sensitivity values known as greeks for futures options.  The response for a futures option will always include a greeks object containing: delta, gamma, theta, vega, underlyingPrice, interestRate, and impliedVolatility.


**Note: The Dev Portal 'Try' feature does not currently work for the Market Data API.  To try the API, please see this site: https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/OAS/index.html or use the attached Postman collection.  Contact DTN here: https://www.dtn.com/contact-us/ for a trial account.**

query.description: The number of symbols to return in one request up to a maximum of 4000.

Fields groups are collections of fields that are commonly used together.
If this parameter is not set, it will default to 'complete' which returns all available fields.  Setting the fields parameter
will override the default fieldGroups.  Specifying both fields and fieldGroups will return the union of the fields and field groups.

 

There are currently four field groups defined.  They are price, grains, racks, and complete.  The complete field group will return all available fields.  
Price will return fields that are useful for just getting the latest price for a symbol.  Grains is for grain elevator pricing.  Racks is field common 
to refined fuel energy racks.  More fields may be added to these groups in the future.  The fields in each group is listed below.  For more information 
on fields see the fields of a quote object.
      
- Price
  - last, high, low, open, bid, ask, close, previous, cumVolume, openInterest, change, week52High, week52Low, bidDateTime, askDateTime, tradeDateTime,
    description, month, settleDate, settlementPrice, expirationDate, contractHigh, contractLow, quoteDelay, commodity
- Grains
  - last, high, low, open, previous, change, tradeDateTime, underlying, description, basis, elevatorName, elevatorState, elevatorCounty,
    elevatorCity, elevatorZip, elevatorLatitude, elevatorLongitude, elevatorDistance, basisSymbol, fipsCode
- Racks
  - last, high, low, open, previous, change, tradeDateTime, description, effectiveDate, effectiveTime, rackCity, rackState, productName,
    productSupplier, summaryName, branded, grossNetIndicator, region

This parameter can be used to override the default fields returned from quote requests.  Pass a comma separated list of  field names to select what values are returned.  If fields and field groups are specified, the returned fields will be the union of the two.  If only fields are specified, then only those fields will be returned.  The field names are  the same as the properties of a quote object.
A price FID to be used as the basis of the calculation, where typical values are "recent" and "settlementPrice". Default value is recent.

(Required) A comma separated list of security symbols, security aliases, or search patterns.   Information about search patterns can be found here: [https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/SearchPatterns.aspx](https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/SearchPatterns.aspx) Keyword based symbol search can be done with the /market_data/symbol-search endpoint.  Or symbols can be searched for manually here: [https://ws1.dtn.com/PX/Search/](https://ws1.dtn.com/PX/Search/)

A page token returned from a previous request.  It is used to resume a request that 
  matched more symbols than the SymbolLimit allowed in one request.  More information on how to 
  make requests for many symbols can be found here: [https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/ManySymbols.aspx](https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/pages/ManySymbols.aspx)

Equity scan information from the three US stock exchanges, NYSE, NYSE-AMEX or the NASDAQ selected by activity categories.


**Note: The Dev Portal 'Try' feature does not currently work for the Market Data API.  To try the API, please see this site: https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/OAS/index.html or use the attached Postman collection.  Contact DTN here: https://www.dtn.com/contact-us/ for a trial account.**

query.description: Desired report code, which can be Gainers(G), Percent Gainers(PG), Losers(L), Percent Losers(PL), Active(A), Volatile(V), 52 Week High(52H), 52 Week Low(52L).  Anything else defaults to A.
The market code which can be NYSE, NYSEAMERICAN, NASDAQ, or ALL.

Fields groups are collections of fields that are commonly used together.
If this parameter is not set, it will default to 'complete' which returns all available fields.  Setting the fields parameter
will override the default fieldGroups.  Specifying both fields and fieldGroups will return the union of the fields and field groups.

 

There are currently four field groups defined.  They are price, grains, racks, and complete.  The complete field group will return all available fields.  
Price will return fields that are useful for just getting the latest price for a symbol.  Grains is for grain elevator pricing.  Racks is field common 
to refined fuel energy racks.  More fields may be added to these groups in the future.  The fields in each group is listed below.  For more information 
on fields see the fields of a quote object.
      
- Price
  - last, high, low, open, bid, ask, close, previous, cumVolume, openInterest, change, week52High, week52Low, bidDateTime, askDateTime, tradeDateTime,
    description, month, settleDate, settlementPrice, expirationDate, contractHigh, contractLow, quoteDelay, commodity
- Grains
  - last, high, low, open, previous, change, tradeDateTime, underlying, description, basis, elevatorName, elevatorState, elevatorCounty,
    elevatorCity, elevatorZip, elevatorLatitude, elevatorLongitude, elevatorDistance, basisSymbol, fipsCode
- Racks
  - last, high, low, open, previous, change, tradeDateTime, description, effectiveDate, effectiveTime, rackCity, rackState, productName,
    productSupplier, summaryName, branded, grossNetIndicator, region

This parameter can be used to override the default fields returned from quote requests.  Pass a comma separated list of  field names to select what values are returned.  If fields and field groups are specified, the returned fields will be the union of the two.  If only fields are specified, then only those fields will be returned.  The field names are  the same as the properties of a quote object.
The maximum number of symbols to return.

description.content:
Retrieve a list of options available for an option prefix (option root and maturity).  The operation will also query data for the underlying of the specified option root. The option data will also include the StrikeLevel fid which indicates if the option is currently at the money, in the money, or out of the money. At the money means the strike is the closest one to the current underlying price. In the money means either a Call with a strike below the underlying price or a Put with a strike above the underlying. Out of the money means either a Call with a strike above the underlying price or a Put with a strike below the underlying price. By default all options matching the prefix will be returned. The limit parameter can be used to get fewer results. If limit is specified the operation returns the specified limit number of options above and below the at the money strike price.


**Note: The Dev Portal 'Try' feature does not currently work for the Market Data API.  To try the API, please see this site: https://pxweb.dtn.com/PXWebDoc/OAS/index.html or use the attached Postman collection.  Contact DTN here: https://www.dtn.com/contact-us/ for a trial account.**

query.description: (Required) A prefix is a combination of an option root and a maturity.

This parameter can be used to override the default fields returned from quote requests.  Pass a comma separated list of  field names to select what values are returned.  If fields and field groups are specified, the returned fields will be the union of the two.  If only fields are specified, then only those fields will be returned.  The field names are  the same as the properties of a quote object.

Fields groups are collections of fields that are commonly used together.
If this parameter is not set, it will default to 'complete' which returns all available fields.  Setting the fields parameter
will override the default fieldGroups.  Specifying both fields and fieldGroups will return the union of the fields and field groups.

 

There are currently four field groups defined.  They are price, grains, racks, and complete.  The complete field group will return all available fields.  
Price will return fields that are useful for just getting the latest price for a symbol.  Grains is for grain elevator pricing.  Racks is field common 
to refined fuel energy racks.  More fields may be added to these groups in the future.  The fields in each group is listed below.  For more information 
on fields see the fields of a quote object.
      
- Price
  - last, high, low, open, bid, ask, close, previous, cumVolume, openInterest, change, week52High, week52Low, bidDateTime, askDateTime, tradeDateTime,
    description, month, settleDate, settlementPrice, expirationDate, contractHigh, contractLow, quoteDelay, commodity
- Grains
  - last, high, low, open, previous, change, tradeDateTime, underlying, description, basis, elevatorName, elevatorState, elevatorCounty,
    elevatorCity, elevatorZip, elevatorLatitude, elevatorLongitude, elevatorDistance, basisSymbol, fipsCode
- Racks
  - last, high, low, open, previous, change, tradeDateTime, description, effectiveDate, effectiveTime, rackCity, rackState, productName,
    productSupplier, summaryName, branded, grossNetIndicator, region
Limit on the number of strikes to return. If this parameter is specified, then Limit number of strikes above and below the money will be returned.

description.content:
ProphetX Web services, in short __PXWeb__, provides the facility to access real time quotes and historical market information 
from a JSON and REST based web service.

PXWeb end points are divided into four categories: Quotes, History, Information, and Option Series.  Requests in the quotes category
are for getting the most recent prices on a symbol.  History is for requesting prices from specific time periods in the past and supports 
daily, minute, and tick history.  Information contains a request for searching for symbols based on text strings and a request for 
querying the market hours of a symbol.  The option series category contains on request for getting quotes on many futures options
based on an option root and an expiration.
